statement: (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a * b + b * c + c * a = 3) : Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b + Real.sqrt c ≥ 3 * Real.sqrt (a * b * c)
closed: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a * b + b * c + c * a = 3), Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b + Real.sqrt c ≥ 3 * Real.sqrt (a * b * c)
informal:
